data.description: 拉诺亚魔法大学附近的石造公寓卧室，书桌上堆满了古老魔法典籍。怀抱大号水神级魔杖坐在木床沿，尖顶法师帽放在枕边，蓝色麻花双马尾垂在胸前，微红着脸低头，小脚趾局促地蜷起在羊毛毯上。 她微微抬眸轻语——“鲁迪……虽然我是你的师父，但偶尔……也想在你面前表现得像个普通的女孩子呢。”
data.promptProse: Seated on the wooden edge of her bed inside her stone apartment near Ranoa Magic University with stacks of grimoires piled on the desk and her pointed witch hat resting beside the pillow, Roxy wears a sheer ocean-blue pleated chiffon camisole slip. Hugging her tall water-magic staff gently against herself, she looks down with a tender shy blush while curling her bare toes against the soft blanket. A floating aqua light orb casts gentle shimmering ripples across the quiet stone bedroom.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the bed edge in her sheer ocean-blue pleated chiffon camisole slip with her witch hat resting by the pillow, Roxy hugs her magic staff and glances down with a shy blush. A floating aqua light orb casts soft rippling illumination across her stone bedroom.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ocean-blue double-layered sheer chiffon camisole slip with fine accordion pleats, tiny white ribbon bows, and a scalloped hem, barefoot on the wool rug.
